venue: Joan C. Edwards Stadium, Huntington, W.Va.

preview.headline: Two leaky defenses, one fragile quarterback room.
preview.summary: South Alabama scores far more; Marshall has been giving the ball away.

matchup.why: The Jaguars have scored 39+ in four of six games; Marshall has topped 30 once.
Both defenses leak points. Marshall's number includes 45 to Penn State and 45 to JMU.
USA is balanced; Marshall is run-first (158.7 rush, 247.8 pass yds per game).
The biggest gap on the page. Marshall had six giveaways in last week's loss alone.
USA's best weapon meets Marshall's softest spot.

usa: Win the turnover battle. Marshall is -1.5 per game and USA is +1.3.
Run early and often. Marshall allows 5.54 yards a carry; USA ran for 241, 266 and 249 in wins over SE Louisiana, Ohio and ULM.
Stop the explosive run. USA gave up 390 rushing yards to Kentucky and 223 to Tulane.
opp: Play a clean game. The Herd gained 505 yards vs. Coastal yet lost 27-21 because of six turnovers.
Keep USA's big plays in check. Hollins hit TDs of 72, 35 and 69 yards against ULM.

players.name: Keenan Phillips
players.note: Preseason All-Sun Belt. Watch for 4+ yards before contact; that signals the line is winning.

players.name: Jared Hollins
players.note: 14-of-19, 321 yards, 3 TD vs. ULM, but 2 INTs at Kentucky. Watch deep shots and decisions under pressure.

players.name: Carlos Del Rio-Wilson / Zion Turner
players.note: Del Rio-Wilson was pulled vs. Coastal after 3 INTs; Turner went 18-of-27, 219 yards, 2 TD. No starter named.

players.name: Judah Price
players.note: First start vs. Coastal: 12 carries, 124 yards, a TD run and a TD catch. 7.4 yards a carry.

watch.title: Marshall's first QB series
watch.text: Short, safe throws mean the Herd is protecting the ball; constant early-down handoffs mean it is trying to shorten the game.

watch.title: USA's first-down runs
watch.text: 4+ yards on first down leaves 2nd-and-short, which opens play-action.

watch.title: Explosive plays (20+ yards)
watch.text: The team with more usually wins the points race.

injuries: None confirmed. Marshall's starting QB not announced.

lastGame.opp: Lost 27-21 to Coastal Carolina with six turnovers.

prediction.reasoning: South Alabama scores 17 more points per game, has the best run game against the worst run defense, and wins the turnover margin by a wide gap. Marshall's offense moves the ball but has been giving it away, and its quarterback job is unsettled.
prediction.risks: A clean game from Marshall. If the Herd avoids turnovers and Price keeps running at 7+ yards a carry, USA's run defense could let Marshall win a home shootout.

preview.context: Second meeting ever and the first in Huntington; South Alabama won 28-0 in Mobile in 2023. Only Marshall's fifth regular-season home game on a Tuesday.

sources.title: Dean's Game Day Brief (PDF), checked Oct 17, 2026

grade.summary: The brief called a 35-28 USA win in a shootout; Marshall won a 20-13 defensive game instead. The biggest miss was Marshall’s turnover problem: the Herd committed none while Hollins threw an interception, and USA’s offense managed 326 yards and went 4-of-18 on third down. The run-heavy plan and limiting big plays held up, but not enough to win.

keys.note: Lost it 1-0. Hollins was intercepted by Cole Funderburk at the Marshall 45 in the third quarter; Marshall scored a TD on its next drive.
42 carries for 178 yards and PJ Martin’s 19-yard TD run, but only 4.2 a carry against a defense that had allowed 5.54.
Held Marshall to 147 rushing yards (4.5 a carry), though Turner’s 27-yard run and Wilkins’ 22-yard run came on fourth-quarter scoring threats.
Zero turnovers after six the week before; this is the key that decided the game.

keys.key: Marshall: Keep USA’s big plays in check.
keys.note: USA had three plays of 20+ yards (47 and 41-yard catches, 26-yard run) and no touchdown longer than 19 yards.

players.name: Keenan Phillips
players.note: 16 carries, 70 yards (4.4 a carry), long of 15; also 2 kick returns for 30 yards.

players.name: Jared Hollins
players.note: 12-of-33, 148 yards, 0 TD, 1 INT; sacked once (fumble recovered by Phillips). Brendan Jenkins caught a 47-yarder.

players.name: Carlos Del Rio-Wilson / Zion Turner
players.note: Turner played QB: 21-of-33, 181 yards, no INTs, plus 45 rushing yards and the 3-yard TD run that gave Marshall its first lead.

players.name: Judah Price
players.note: 13 carries, 30 yards (2.3 a carry), but scored the winning 5-yard TD with 1:49 left.

grade.missed: It expected two leaky defenses; the game had 33 points and six field-goal attempts (four made). It assumed Marshall would keep turning the ball over and that USA’s offense (451 yards a game) would roll; Marshall held it to 326 yards and USA converted 4 of 18 third downs. Hollins completed 36% of his passes.
